title: FACET JSON Report v0
description: Machine-readable QC report schema v0 for segfacet. Extended by Stage 2 with a 'features' block.

schema_version.description: Version discriminator for this report schema. Always '0.1' for v0 reports.

config_version.description: The schema_version from the HeuristicConfig that produced this report, for reproducibility.

verdict.description: Overall QC verdict for the case.

reasons.description: Case-level QC findings (not tied to a specific label).

per_label.description: Per-label QC findings, keyed by the string representation of the integer label value.

features.description: Optional Stage 2 geometric/topological feature block. Absent for verdict-only (item 009) reports; present when the pipeline serialises computed features.

findings.description: Optional Stage 4 rule-engine findings (item 035), embedded verbatim from Finding.to_dict(). Absent for reports that did not run the rule engine.

reference_delta.description: Optional Stage 6 delta-to-reference block (item 046): per-label distribution-relative metrics scored against a loaded reference distribution. Absent for reports that did not run the delta-to-reference computation.

run_manifest.description: Optional Stage 17 run-manifest provenance block (item 096): segmenter version/SHA, weights hash, seed, dataset id, post-processing toggles, and resolved package versions. Absent for reports that were not given any manifest flags.

reason.description: A single QC finding with a human-readable message, severity, and optional label attribution.

labels.description: Integer label values that contributed to this finding. Empty for case-level findings.

finding.description: A single heuristic rule-engine finding (item 026), embedded verbatim from Finding.to_dict().

rule_id.description: Identifier of the rule that produced this finding (e.g. 'bounds').

detector_id.description: Rule-local id (item 164) of the detector branch that produced this finding; optional, empty for a report written before this item.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why this finding was raised.

labels.description: Offending vertebra integer label values. Empty for a case-level finding.

features.description: Consolidated features for a case: per-label kind blocks (geometry, components, centroid and, when computed, curve, orientation, neighbourhood and intensity), the case-level 'case' container (level sequence and, when computed, curve and intensity) and the 'pairs' container (overlap pairs and adjacent-pair values).

features_version.description: Version discriminator for the features block, independent of the top-level schema_version. Stage 3 bumps this to '0.3'; item 215 bumped the base value to '0.2' (the per-label intensity kind) and the Stage 3 value from '0.2' to '0.3' (the per-label Stage 3 fields moved under per_label.{label}). Item 216 moved the case-level fields under 'case' and 'pairs' without a further bump.

per_label.description: Per-label feature records, keyed by the string representation of the integer label value.

case.description: Case-wide values (item 216): the level sequence (null when not computed, e.g. zero labels) and, when computed, the spinal curve and the case-level intensity block.

pairs.description: Values that belong to a pair of labels (item 216): the voxel-level overlaps and the adjacent-pair values.

stage3_unavailable.description: Optional diagnostic recording why the Stage 3 spline fit was not attempted (item 129) -- present only when at least two labels are present but Stage 3 was skipped, e.g. two centroids sharing an exact mm-coordinate. Deliberately outside the feature catalogue.

stage3Unavailable.description: Records why the Stage 3 spline fit was skipped (item 129).

detail.description: Single-line human-readable explanation naming the offending levels and coordinate.

levels.description: The two coincident level names, in the order the coincidence helper reported them.

labels.description: The two coincident integer labels, in the same order as 'levels'.

labelFeatures.description: All features for a single integer label. The identity (label, level_name) is stored once, here; every other copy was merged onto it (item 215). Geometry, components and centroid come from the label map and are required. Curve, orientation and neighbourhood are present when Stage 3 ran, and intensity when a scan was supplied.

level_name.description: Anatomical vertebra name (e.g. 'L3'), or the convention's UNKNOWN sentinel for unmapped labels.

bbox.description: Axis-aligned bounding box with named per-axis min/max coordinates.

fragmentation_index.description: Fraction of label voxels in the largest connected component (item 025). Range (0, 1]: 1.0 = intact, <1.0 = fragmented.

stray_component_count.description: Number of components other than the dominant one (item 098): every component but the single largest.

stray_component_sizes.description: Voxel count per stray component -- component_sizes[1:], every component but the dominant one (item 098).

stray_volume_mm3.description: Summed physical volume (mm^3) of the stray components -- every component but the dominant one (item 098).

stray_volume_fraction.description: Fraction of label volume outside the dominant component -- the complement of largest_component_fraction (item 098).

stray_contact_area_mm2.description: Neighbour-label contact area (mm^2): the maximum, over every stray component, of that component's 6-neighbour face-contact area with any single other non-zero label (item 167).

stray_contact_label.description: The other label id carrying the interface at stray_contact_area_mm2, or 0 when stray_contact_area_mm2 == 0.0 (item 167).

component_contacts.description: One entry per component, in component_sizes order (index 0 is the label's largest component): its 6-neighbour face-contact measure relative to its own surface (item 187).

label_contact_fraction.description: The same relative contact measure as component_contacts, computed once more over the label as a whole (item 187).

centroid.description: Per-label centre-of-mass in voxel and physical (mm) coordinates (item 013).

centroid_voxel.description: (x, y, z) centre of mass in voxel-index space.

centroid_mm.description: (x, y, z) centre of mass in mm.

overlapPair.description: A single pair of overlapping labels (item 015), stored as pairs.overlaps[]. Ordered so label_a < label_b. Each side's level name is stored once, at per_label.{label}.level_name (item 216).

sequence.description: The case's level sequence (features.case.sequence), or null when not computed (e.g. zero labels).

curve.description: Global spinal curve descriptors (features.case.curve); present when at least two labels allowed the Stage 3 fit.

intensity.description: Optional Stage 8 case-level intensity block (items 061, 216): availability and provenance of the intensity features (the per-label statistics are stored under per_label.{label}.intensity, item 215). Absent for runs that did not run the intensity extraction.

pairFeatures.description: Values that belong to a pair of labels (item 216), stored as features.pairs.

overlaps.description: Voxel-level overlap between label pairs. Empty when no labels overlap.

adjacent.description: Values of each pair of adjacent labels in the anatomical sequence; present for every record with at least one label.

relationships.description: The case's level sequence (item 014, stored as features.case.sequence since item 216).

present_levels.description: Recognised level names in canonical head-to-tail order.

missing_levels.description: Levels absent within the observed [min..max] span, in canonical order.

out_of_order_labels.description: Level names (in the integer-label input order, which is the order this array alone is computed in) that broke canonical monotonicity.

order.description: Every integer label of the record in the one anatomical order that every per-label sequence, array and Stage 3 extractor input in the record follows (item 216): the CANONICAL_ORDER rank of the label's level name with unrecognised names last, then the integer label (item 198). Compare with the sorted keys of per_label to see where it departs from integer order.

stage3OffsetEntry.description: A label's position relative to the fitted spinal curve (per_label.{label}.curve): its perpendicular offset from the spline (item 018) and its normalised arc-length position along the label-free path through the centroids (items 198, 210). No identity copy; the entry's own label and level_name name it (item 215). The six offset fields come together (any one requires the rest), and path_u may stand alone: the pipeline emits a path_u-only curve when a monotonic-consistency result is supplied without spline offsets.

closest_u.description: Spline parameter value (0..1) of the closest point on the curve.

offset_mm.description: Euclidean distance (mm) to the closest spline point.

is_terminal.description: True for the first/last entry of the ordered centroid sequence it was measured in (item 123). Optional -- an entry omitting it is treated as interior (False) by every consumer.

path_u.description: This label's u: its normalised arc length in [0, 1] along the label-free minimum-spanning-tree longest path through the vertebra centroids (item 210), directed to have the fewest inversions against the anatomical order; a different quantity from closest_u, the position on the fitted spline. One element of the former stage3.monotonic_consistency.u_values array.

stage3OrientationEntry.description: Which way a label's vertebral body points (per_label.{label}.orientation): the PCA principal axis (item 019), the spline tangent (item 121) and the tangent's unwrapped per-plane angles (item 131, 122). No identity copy (item 215). Either the PCA pair (principal_axis, eigenvalue_ratio) or the three unwrapped tangent angles must be present: the PCA and the curvature fields come from independent optional sources.

principal_axis.description: Unit vector (3 floats) of the first principal component in mm-space.

eigenvalue_ratio.description: Ratio of the largest to the second-largest PCA eigenvalue.

spline_closest_u.description: Spline parameter (0..1) of this centroid's closest point on the fitted curve (item 121).

spline_tangent.description: Unit-normalised, direction-normalised curve tangent at spline_closest_u (item 121).

spline_tangent_coronal_deg.description: Signed in-plane tilt in the coronal (R-S) plane at spline_closest_u, wrapped to (-180, 180] (item 121).

spline_tangent_sagittal_deg.description: Signed in-plane tilt in the sagittal (A-S) plane at spline_closest_u, wrapped to (-180, 180] (item 121).

tangent_angle_deg.description: Spline tangent angle (degrees) at this label's u value, relative to the z-axis, computed from tangents normalised so the sequence advances superiorly (items 131, 215). One element of the former stage3.curvature.tangent_angles_deg array.

tangent_coronal_unwrapped_deg.description: Signed tangent angle (degrees) in the coronal (R-S) plane at this label, degrees(atan2(t_R, t_S)), unwrapped along the spine (items 122, 215); the same tangent as spline_tangent_coronal_deg, read unwrapped instead of wrapped. One element of the former stage3.curvature.coronal_tangent_angles_deg array.

tangent_sagittal_unwrapped_deg.description: Signed tangent angle (degrees) in the sagittal (A-S) plane at this label, unwrapped and direction-normalised like tangent_coronal_unwrapped_deg (items 122, 215). One element of the former stage3.curvature.sagittal_tangent_angles_deg array.

stage3Curvature.description: Global spinal curve descriptors (features.case.curve): the four curvature scalars and whether the anatomical order advances along the label-free path. The three per-label tangent-angle arrays are stored one scalar per label under per_label.{label}.orientation since item 215; the adjacent-pair arrays under pairs.adjacent since item 216.

total_curvature_deg.description: The larger of coronal_curvature_deg and sagittal_curvature_deg -- the sweep in the anatomical plane the spine turns in most. See curvature_plane for which one.

coronal_curvature_deg.description: max - min of the labels' tangent_coronal_unwrapped_deg -- the coronal-plane sweep. 0.0 for a curve confined to the sagittal plane.

sagittal_curvature_deg.description: max - min of the labels' tangent_sagittal_unwrapped_deg -- the sagittal-plane sweep. 0.0 for a curve confined to the coronal plane.

curvature_plane.description: "coronal" when coronal_curvature_deg >= sagittal_curvature_deg, else "sagittal". An exact tie (including 0.0/0.0) resolves to "coronal".

is_monotonic.description: True iff u, the normalised arc length along the label-free minimum-spanning-tree longest path through the centroids (item 210), increases at every consecutive pair in anatomical order. Each label's own u is per_label.{label}.curve.path_u.

stage3SpacingConsistency.description: Values of each pair of adjacent labels in the anatomical sequence (features.pairs.adjacent). Only spacings_mm exists on every record with at least one label; the statistics and the two pair arrays are Stage 3 values derived from that same sequence.

spacings_mm.description: Euclidean distances (mm) between the centroids of consecutive labels of the anatomical sequence (case.sequence.order): every label, unrecognised labels last (item 216; the integer-label order is anatomically meaningless). Length is n_labels - 1, and [] below two labels; present on every record with at least one label, including one whose centroids coincide.

cv_spacing.description: Coefficient of variation of spacings_mm. Stage 3 only.

deviations_mm.description: Signed deviation of each spacings_mm element from its mean. Stage 3 only.

outlier_pairs.description: Level-name pairs whose spacing is flagged as an outlier. Each entry is a 2-element list [level_a, level_b]. Stage 3 only.

inter_tangent_angles_deg.description: Angle (degrees) between consecutive tangent vectors of the anatomical sequence. Length is n_centroids - 1. Read as if the tangents were normalised so the sequence advances superiorly; already invariant to traversal direction, so no negation is needed to produce that reading. Stage 3 only.

non_monotonic_pairs.description: Level-name pairs where u, the normalised arc length along the label-free path through the centroids (item 210), did not advance in anatomical order. Each entry is a 2-element list [level_a, level_b]. Stage 3 only.

stage3NeighbourhoodEntry.description: One vertebra's local neighbourhood comparison result (item 110), stored as per_label.{label}.neighbourhood. No identity copy (item 215).

window_labels.description: Integer label values of every vertebra in the sliding window (including the focal vertebra).

stats.description: Per-feature window statistics, keyed by feature name (e.g. spacing_mm, offset_mm, volume_mm3).

deviation_score.description: max() of the leave-one-out z-scores of the scored feature subset.

is_outlier.description: True when deviation_score exceeds the configured threshold.

stage3NeighbourhoodFeatureStats.description: Window statistics for one named feature at one focal vertebra.

mean.description: Mean of the feature's values over the whole window (including the focal vertebra).

median.description: Median of the feature's values over the whole window (including the focal vertebra).

std.description: Standard deviation of the feature's values over the whole window (including the focal vertebra).

z_score.description: Leave-one-out z-score of the focal vertebra's value against the window's other members only.

referenceDelta.description: Stage 6 delta-to-reference block (item 046): per-label distribution-relative metrics scored against a loaded reference distribution.

reference_delta_version.description: Version discriminator for this block, independent of the report and reference schema versions.

reference_schema_version.description: The schema_version of the reference distribution used to compute this block.

stratum.description: The size stratum requested when computing this block (e.g. 'all').

per_label.description: Per-label delta results, keyed by the string representation of the integer label value.

referenceLabelDelta.description: One label's delta-to-reference result, keyed by the label in referenceDelta.per_label. It carries no copy of the label or its level_name: those are stored once, on per_label.{label} (item 215).

available.description: False when the (level_name, stratum) pair is absent from the reference; features/distribution_distance are then empty/null, not an error.

distribution_distance.description: RMS of the defined per-feature robust_z values. Null when unavailable or no feature has a defined robust_z.

features.description: Per-feature deltas, keyed by feature name. Only features the reference tracks and the case carries are present.

imageFeatures.description: Stage 8 image-based feature block (item 061), case-level fields only since item 215: availability and provenance of the intensity features. The per-label statistics are stored as per_label.{label}.intensity in the features block.

image_features_version.description: Version discriminator for this block, independent of the report schema_version.

available.description: False when intensity was attempted but unavailable (no scan / no backend), not an error.

radiomics_available.description: Whether PyRadiomics produced any extended features for this run.

backend.description: Provenance marker for the intensity/radiomics backend used (e.g. 'builtin', 'pyradiomics').

imageLabelFeatures.description: One label's image-based feature record, stored as per_label.{label}.intensity: first-order intensity statistics plus optional radiomics extended features. No identity copy (item 215).

extended.description: Flat radiomics feature map (item 060), keyed by feature name. Empty on the builtin (first-order-only) path.

firstOrderIntensity.description: First-order intensity statistics for a single label (item 059).

referenceFeatureDelta.description: One tracked feature's delta-to-reference result for one label.

value.description: The case's value for this (label, feature).

z_score.description: (value - mean) / std. Null when the reference std == 0.

robust_z.description: (value - p50) / (IQR / 1.349). Null when the reference IQR == 0.

percentile_rank.description: 0..100, piecewise-linear interpolation over the stored percentile grid.

out_of_range.description: True when value is below the lower_pct bound or above the upper_pct bound.

runManifest.description: Stage 17 run-manifest provenance block (item 096): caller-supplied segmenter/dataset identity plus auto-resolved package versions.

segmenter_version.description: Caller-supplied segmenter version string, or null when not given.

segmenter_sha.description: Caller-supplied segmenter commit SHA (or similar), or null when not given.

weights_hash.description: Caller-supplied hash of the segmenter's weights, or null when not given.

seed.description: Caller-supplied integer seed, or null when not given.

dataset_id.description: Caller-supplied dataset identifier, or null when not given.

postproc_toggles.description: Caller-supplied free-form JSON-compatible mapping of post-processing toggles, or null when not given.

resolved_versions.description: Auto-populated mapping of package name to its resolved installed version string (null per entry when not discoverable).
